name: data360-mcp
description: Three MCP (stdio) servers that wrap the existing Data360 audit harnesses + real backend endpoints: data360-health (API/cache probes), data360-ux (render_all + front_perf Playwright sweeps), data360-roles (RBAC persona matrix). Servers are CLIENTS of the running backend/app; they hold no SVC env.

scripts.//note: Install the SDK ONLY (never bare `npm install`): bare install would pull a duplicate @playwright/test + download browsers. Playwright is a peerDependency provided by the monorepo root node_modules (already installed, incl. browsers) and resolves upward at runtime.
scripts.postinstall-note: If you ever need a clean SDK install: npm install @modelcontextprotocol/sdk@^1.29.0

//playwright: Provided by the monorepo root (/Users/datalab360/Documents/data360_pro/datalab360Front/node_modules/@playwright/test, v1.58.2 with browsers already downloaded). Declared as a peerDependency on purpose so `npm install` in this dir does NOT duplicate it. Node ESM resolution walks up from tools/mcp -> tools -> repo root to find it. Only the data360-ux server imports it.
